recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-18409 follow-up is needed unless FHIR-I chooses to revisit modifierExtension semantics more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-18409 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core DomainResource, raised against STU3, asking to append "and/or the understanding of the containing element's descendants" to the DomainResource.modifierExtension definition.
initial_application: Git commit 9507ff17d7 ("GF#18409 - clarification about modification") applied the requested wording to the then-authoritative DomainResource spreadsheet and the BackboneElement spreadsheet. Commit 33b409a4b6 later converted DomainResource into source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml while preserving the wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists domainresource as an active abstract infrastructure resource, and current DomainResource.modifierExtension includes the requested descendant wording. Active BackboneElement and BackboneType definitions also include the wording. Later issue FHIR-27916 touched the same DomainResource definition only while fixing dom-3/apostrophe escaping and did not change the FHIR-18409 semantics. Old wording remains only in source/profiles/cda.profile.xml, whose fhir.ini entry is commented out.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current in-build source already implements the Jira decision and no additional in-scope source location requires a correction.
